summary: We’re Hiring: Software Engineer Intern - Join DigiStay as a software engineer intern and work on building real products end-to-end, collaborating with the core tech team, and learning how modern systems are built.
responsibilities: Build real products end-to-end — backend APIs, dashboards, and user interfaces
Work closely with the core tech team on features that ship to production
Debug, break things, fix them, and build again
Participate in brainstorming sessions where ideas move faster than cricket balls during break matches
Learn how modern, scalable systems are built in the real world
required_skills: Strong foundation in Computer Science fundamentals
Experience with at least one modern framework: React / Next.js / NestJS / Node.js
Curiosity about how systems connect — databases, APIs, queues, services
Strong problem-solving mindset (you’re okay Googling 27 times if needed)
Comfortable with startup chaos — fast-moving, creative, and ever-evolving
Grit. When something doesn’t work, you don’t quit — you figure it out
qualifications: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering / related fields
Passion for technology and a strong desire to learn and grow
benefits: We work hard, we party harder
Quick cricket breaks when the brain’s fried
Code with music, movies, or TED talks in the background
Tech-room vibes straight out of Ted Lasso’s locker room
Real ownership, real learning, real impact
